verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated export feature, but the evidence implies you could get your files out. Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder/Explorer and sync back, journal entries are stored as Markdown files, Finder tags sync bidirectionally, and the `poly` CLI can read files from the terminal. Together these suggest copying your stored files out in their native or open formats, though as a workaround rather than an export path. Missing for 10: a documented bulk-export or takeout feature, export of Poly-derived data (Mind memory, indexes, version history, Poly-only metadata), account deletion or offboarding docs, and independent confirmation that a full export works.
